title: Archive and Static
author: Noor Lockridge
blurb: Hazel Marchetti, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
